# Code comparison (generated by `scripts/compare_code.py`)

Run on Nov 15, 2026 to check that Cold Movers contains no code copied from a competitor, and to measure how much
it shares with the IRSA tutorials it follows (BSD-3-Clause, credited in DATA_AND_RESOURCES.md). The other
repositories were read as text only; none of their code was imported or run. Summary and interpretation:
[ORIGINALITY_AND_PROVENANCE.md](ORIGINALITY_AND_PROVENANCE.md), section 6.

| Repository compared | Commit | Licence | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| github.com/Nsa-2026/skyshift | a6427d8 (2026-11-15 18:05 +0100) | Apache-2.0 | Competitor (Space Apps 2026, same challenge) |
| github.com/astropy/photutils | c05d860 (2026-11-13) | BSD-3-Clause | Unrelated baseline, certainly not copied |
| github.com/Caltech-IPAC/irsa-tutorials | 6e0aff6 (2026-11-13) | BSD-3-Clause | Tutorials we followed (code cells extracted from the notebooks) |

Cold Movers was compared after rewording three sentences that matched SkyShift texts (before the rewording,
section 4 also listed "by blinking two photographs of the same sky taken days apart" in README.md and app.py,
and "maps the whole sky every six months in 102 colours" in app.py).

Reproduce: clone the repositories, then `python -I scripts/compare_code.py <skyshift> <photutils>`.
